title: Establishment of Human Cellular Disease Models for Wilson Disease
brief_summary: Establishment of human cellular disease models for Wilson disease for an individualized therapy develop-ment having the capacity to address both hepatic and neurologic forms of the disease
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Informed consent will be obtained from the patient or the parents before any study related procedures.
* Patients of both genders older than 6 months and younger than 80 years
* The patient has a diagnosis of Wilson dis-ease

Exclusion Criteria:

* No Informed consent from the patient or the parents before any study related procedures
* Patients of both genders younger than 6 months and older than 80 years
* No diagnosis of Wilson disease
study_population: Patients has a diagnosis of Wilson disease
